summary.key_theme: Alphabet 激進的 AI 資本支出引發市場對自由現金流的擔憂，但長期 AI 競爭力與機構投資人布局仍提供支撐。

bullish.title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Tripled Berkshire's Stake in This Megacap AI Stock
bullish.reason: 波克夏海瑟威大幅加碼 Alphabet 股票，顯示價值型投資大師對其 AI 長期布局的信心，對股價具備強大背書效果。

bullish.title: GOOGL Bets on AI to Defend Search Leadership: More Upside Ahead?
bullish.reason: AI 搜尋功能月活躍用戶突破 10 億，顯示 Alphabet 在核心搜尋業務的防禦能力與變現潛力，有利於長期營收成長。

bullish.title: The Discount On GOOGL Stock Looks Overdone
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Alphabet 目前估值相較於市場處於折價狀態，認為近期拋售過度，具備逢低布局價值。

bullish.title: Verizon Just Signed a More Than $1 Billion Dark Fiber Deal With Google
bullish.reason: 與 Verizon 簽署超過 10 億美元的暗光纖協議，強化了 Alphabet 在雲端與 AI 基礎設施的實體布局。

bullish.title: As Wall Street Frets Over Alphabet's AI Spending Binge, Mark Cuban Says Google Is Simply Doing What Worked in 1998
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Mark Cuban 公開支持 Alphabet 的資本支出策略，有助於緩解市場對高額 AI 投資的恐慌情緒。

bullish.title: Google’s AI Waitlist Just Hit $514 Billion
bullish.reason: 財報中隱含的龐大 AI 需求潛力，雖然短期造成支出壓力，但長期來看代表了強勁的市場需求。

bearish.title: Google spent $490 million a day on AI and burned $5.9 billion in cash
bearish.reason: Alphabet 創下上市以來首次自由現金流為負的季度，每日高達 4.9 億美元的 AI 支出引發市場對獲利能力的質疑。

bearish.title: Google (GOOGL) Faces $1 Billion EU Antitrust Fine And New Trade Friction
bearish.reason: 歐盟因違反數位市場法案開出 8.9 億歐元（約 10 億美元）罰單，增加營運成本與監管不確定性。

bearish.title: Alphabet Is Getting ‘Ambitious’ With AI. Don’t Get Ambitious With GOOGL Stock.
bearish.reason: 警告投資人不要對 Alphabet 的 AI 擴張過度樂觀，資本支出預算持續調升將壓縮短期股價表現。

bearish.title: Google and Tesla lost half a trillion dollars this week as their suppliers cashed in
bearish.reason: 市場開始質疑 AI 基礎設施投資的實際回報率，導致 Alphabet 與 Tesla 等科技巨頭市值大幅縮水。

bearish.title: Reddit Could Limit Google’s Access to Its Content
bearish.reason: Reddit 與 Google 之間的內容授權爭議可能影響 AI 模型訓練數據來源，增加潛在法律與營運風險。

bearish.title: Tesla, Intel, Google All Dropped After Earnings
bearish.reason: 反映財報後科技股整體疲軟的市場情緒，Alphabet 股價受大盤拖累。

bearish.title: Trump Defends DOJ's New York Times Reporter Subpoenas as Google Is Drawn Into Air Force One Leak Investigation
bearish.reason: Google 被捲入政府洩密調查的傳票事件，雖非核心業務問題，但增加了企業形象的負面風險。

neutral.title: Why Retail Traders Couldn’t Take Their Eyes Off These Stocks Last Week
neutral.reason: 僅為市場熱門股回顧，未提供具體影響股價的新資訊。

neutral.title: Google’s $205 Billion AI Bet Terrified Investors. Here’s Why the Market Was Wrong
neutral.reason: 針對財報負面反應的觀點分析，正反意見平衡，未對股價產生直接推動力。

neutral.title: 2 Stocks to Buy Now as Google Raises Its AI Spending Forecast Yet Again
neutral.reason: 重點在於推薦供應鏈個股，而非 Alphabet 本身。

neutral.title: 2 Neocloud Stocks to Buy Now After Google Earnings
neutral.reason: 同樣聚焦於雲端供應鏈個股的投資建議。

neutral.title: Alphabet's Google Signs EU AI Content Transparency Code
neutral.reason: 簽署透明度準則屬於例行性合規行為，對股價影響中性。
